description: Main source file for a Flutter note organizer app, including app setup, data models, database helper, state management, UI screens, and search functionality.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Data model representing a single note with serialization methods.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: Singleton helper class for managing SQLite database operations.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: State management class for handling notes list and search filtering.

classes.name: NotesHomeScreen
classes.description: Main screen widget displaying list of notes with navigation to note creation/editing.

classes.name: NotesListView
classes.description: Widget showing the list of notes with separator and empty state handling.

classes.name: NoteListTile
classes.description: Widget displaying individual note summary in the list with tap to edit and long press to delete.

classes.name: NoteEditScreen
classes.description: Screen for creating or editing a note with save and validation functionality.

classes.name: NotesSearchDelegate
classes.description: Custom search delegate for filtering notes based on search query.

classes.name: DeleteNoteDialog
classes.description: Confirmation dialog for deleting a note.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for various widgets to generate their UI.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from database, optionally filtered by search query.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Add a new note to the database.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Update an existing note in the database.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID from the database.

methods.name: _saveNote
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing note.
